objective: Build and iteratively optimize a Rust-first GPTgrep system with measured live advantages over the PageIndex Flash baseline
authority: User project ownership mandate; routine implementation, harness, CI and releases authorized within the agreed direction

benchmark.baseline: Actual pinned PageIndex Flash/local SDK execution; local Codex backend substitution explicitly identified

original_oss_reference.runtime: original local PageIndexClient Flash; no PageIndex Cloud key, OpenAI API key required for hosted LLM
original_oss_reference.index_model: gpt-5.6-luna default, indexing effort unspecified by original run
original_oss_reference.cost_scope: answering only; shared one-off indexing omitted; estimated with the original litellm price map; original speed tier is not recorded, Standard alignment is an inference

original_indexing_cost.role: separate descriptive comparison only; six missing costs are unknown

original_oss_reference.role: published native aggregate quality reference; no per-task paired evidence in results.json

benchmark.qualified_live_reference: R8 original PageIndex SDK/Flash tools through Codex adapter: index Luna/medium, reader Luna/max/fast, judge Luna/high/fast; 60/62 with paired per-task and tool evidence. Distinct from original results.json.
benchmark.first_release_external_model_policy: Keep the frozen actual PageIndex Flash + gpt-5.6-luna baseline. From the current optimization cursor onward, GPTgrep candidate/recovery/confirmation runs use only gpt-6-luna Fast; earlier GPTgrep 5.6 arms are retained as historical diagnostics. This is a disclosed cross-model whole-system comparison, not a retrieval-only causal comparison.
benchmark.index_reasoning_effort: medium (documented API default, explicit through adapted runtime)

index_concurrency.reported_measurement: observed process overlap; no inferred provider concurrency

reader_judge_concurrency.strategy: bounded reader stage followed by bounded independent judge stage
reader_judge_concurrency.paired_policy: Use matching ceilings and stage strategy in both systems; bind changes into new run identities
reader_judge_concurrency.accounting: Include in-flight reservations, failures and interrupted attempts in the shared cap; report measured overlap and actual stage wall time separately

gates.name: Offline correctness, source freshness, bounded execution and independent review
Real Jev and local Codex useful outcomes, not transport-only success
Actual full-system and upstream SDK execution with qualified tools in the live benchmark
Full cohort paired benchmark and ablations under declared comparable conditions
Demonstrated advantage with no hidden quality, citation or ingestion regression
Verified source/release artifacts, PoUW, backup and continuation

advantage_rule.quality: One frozen, independently confirmed complete GPTgrep gpt-6-luna/Fast effort configuration strictly exceeds original PageIndex results.json 60/62: at least 61 correct of all 62 tasks, retaining failures and abstentions in the denominator; retain paired R8 per-task disagreements separately
advantage_rule.grounding: No stale source accepted; citation validity and ingestion coverage at least baseline under the declared scope
advantage_rule.efficiency: The same qualifying GPTgrep run has complete QA Codex reasoning tokens priced at current Standard API rates plus observed Jev cost, with typed communication/remote-service failed attempts excluded from experimental comparison cost but retained as separate failure/usage/unknown-billing signals, strictly below original PageIndex answer-only estimated $0.003607/question over all 62 tasks; report Fast experimental API-equivalent, both indexing costs and judge cost separately
advantage_rule.uncertainty: Report repetitions/sample count and paired uncertainty; a small smoke suite cannot establish the complete goal
advantage_rule.missing_metrics: Unavailable, never zero or success; missing required non-excluded QA model usage, effective tier, Jev cost or price provenance blocks QA cost acceptance; typed communication/remote-service failures may be excluded only from the comparison numerator with separate attempted/known-usage/unknown-billing reporting; generic legacy failures are unclassified; incomplete index cost is a subtotal

release_policy: The first experimental/research-preview publication requires accepted G3-G5: full-system live paired PageIndex-OSS-Benchmark evidence of a minimum verified advantage. Source commits and CI may proceed; no first release tag/publication from partial progress or smoke-only evidence.
rsi_policy: Use failures to propose and test scoped changes; keep raw receipts, learned findings and executable policy distinct; no unreviewed global ingestion

system_contract.core: Jev routing and evidence reranking are mandatory for default search, ask and summarize
system_contract.failure_policy: Missing credentials or provider/schema failures are explicit; no silent local-only downgrade
system_contract.primitives: Explicit regex and lexical operations remain available for exact inspection and controlled ablations
system_contract.indexing: Current parsing and index publication are deterministic local preparation; Jev indexing assistance is not yet implemented
system_contract.scope: Exact source-relative document filtering is applied before lexical/semantic candidate budgets

diagnostic_signals: observed provider cost and missing accounting

embedding_rag_comparator.milestone: next-version backlog after successful first research-preview release
embedding_rag_comparator.execution: preparation, experiments and benchmarks pending until that milestone
requirements: declare chunking, overlap, cosine/top-k and context budget

first_release_gate.baseline: PageIndex Flash + GPT-5.6, exact role profiles recorded and unchanged for the first-release target
first_release_gate.system: RAW documents -> LiteParse/Rust PageIndex/tgrep build -> required Jev routing/reranking -> local Codex GPT-6 Luna/Fast with declared high, xhigh or max reasoning effort
first_release_gate.model_ablation: Earlier predeclared GPTgrep 5.6-versus-6 full-cohort arms remain historical diagnostics. Do not launch new GPTgrep 5.6 arms or recoveries for this preview. Explore GPT-6 high/xhigh/max as labelled whole-configuration variants, then freeze a GPT-6 candidate and run a fresh full-cohort confirmation without per-task best-of selection.

cost_threshold.gptgrep_scope: 62-question answering Codex planner/reader measured tokens normalized to Standard API prices plus observed Jev routing/reranking cost; exclude only attempts typed as communication/remote-service failures from the comparison numerator, retain them in failure and billing-unknown sidecars; index construction excluded
cost_threshold.reference_scope: original PageIndex results.json answer-only litellm estimate; indexing excluded; Standard-tier alignment inferred because original speed tier is not recorded
cost_threshold.fast_experiment_cost: report separately from the Standard-normalized G5 comparison using the actually observed effective Fast/priority tier
cost_threshold.index_cost: report each system separately; original PageIndex documents.json cost is incomplete for six PDFs and only a known subtotal may be shown
cost_threshold.judge_cost: reported separately, excluded from both compared retrieval systems
cost_threshold.billing_interpretation: public API price-card equivalent from observed tokens, not observed ChatGPT subscription charge; exclusion does not assert zero provider bill
cost_threshold.unknown_policy: no pass when any required non-excluded QA usage, Jev cost, observed experimental tier or applicable price is missing; generic legacy failures do not qualify for exclusion

first_release_gate.interpretation: Cross-model results measure whole-system advantage against the user-selected PageIndex baseline; disclose model and adapter effects, and do not claim model-independent retrieval superiority.
first_release_gate.method: General improvements from clean development signals; complete62-task live A/B, report historical8/54 split separately, no smoke substitution

forbidden_product_inputs: task identifiers used as answer or route selectors
benchmark_integrity.dataset_loading: runtime from pinned source, no vendored task question/answer literals
benchmark_integrity.reader_inputs: question, protocol-permitted document scope, retrieved source evidence
benchmark_integrity.scoring_inputs: gold answers and evidence annotations are isolated to judge/scorer
benchmark_integrity.regression_tests: synthetic corpus variations; no benchmark task special cases
benchmark_integrity.split_policy: preserve preregistered development/heldout membership; no post-result split redefinition
benchmark_integrity.pattern_specialization: Forbidden: benchmark-specific document types/question templates/answer formats/location priors/few-shot task examples
benchmark_integrity.index_inputs: Raw documents only; no evaluation questions or annotations
benchmark_integrity.cross_question_state: No judge state/gold/previous verdicts in subsequent reader sessions or indexes

live_execution_rule.offline_tests: implementation correctness only, not benchmark results
live_execution_rule.failures: all selected tasks remain in denominator
live_execution_rule.adapter_qualification: actual successful source-bound SDK tool roundtrip retained from live benchmark, not process-only acceptance

runtime_privacy: Use caller-selected authenticated runtime with portable public parameters; custom workstation launchers/account routing remain ignored local-only
